compute_config_names_response: create a function that retrieves all config names for a HuggingFace dataset and returns a sorted list with the default config first
get_dataset_config_names: call get_dataset_config_names from the datasets library to fetch config names for a given dataset path and optional auth token
get_dataset_default_config_name: call get_dataset_default_config_name from the datasets library to get the default config when a dataset has multiple configs
DatasetConfigNamesJobRunner_compute: run the DatasetConfigNamesJobRunner compute method to get a CompleteJobResult with config names for a dataset using app configuration
DatasetConfigNamesJobRunner_get_job_type: call get_job_type on DatasetConfigNamesJobRunner to return the string 'dataset-config-names' as the job type identifier
